topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct, employee handbook, and FERPA and security sanctions; annual acknowledgment of POL-05
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (96%); sanctions log (3 in fiscal 2026)

control_description: Board of directors with 2 independent directors; audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports and the Qualified Individual's annual written report
gap: Quarterly reporting formalized only from 2026-09; one quarterly meeting on record
remediation: Hold and minute each quarterly report through the observation period

control_description: Qualified Individual, CIO oversight, data owners, and system owner designated; reporting lines in POL-01
Qualified security staff, MSSP, and vCISO; annual awareness training
gap: No role-based training for corporate partnerships, financial aid, or the service desk; no verification of vCISO continuing education

control_description: Accountability through POL-01 roles, sanctions, and POA&M owners
Security information from the SIEM, EDR, posture management, and inventories
gap: SIS and LMS activity, which drive partner reports, is not in the SIEM; inventory misses 14 SaaS tools

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; annual acknowledgment; monthly security reminders
Partner agreements state security commitments; incident contacts for partners
gap: No system description or security commitments document for partners; partner notice terms differ across the 9 agreements
remediation: Write the system description; standard 72-hour incident notice addendum for all partners

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives for the employer education services (availability 99.5%, restore within 24 hours, confidentiality of sponsored students' data) defined in partner agreements and P01
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covering the SILP and partner services
Fraud risk assessed: refund diversion, fraudulent applicants, partner invoicing errors
evidence: P01 R-005, R-006; P08 identity fraud runbook
gap: Fraud controls (applicant verification, refund step-up) not yet operating

control_description: Material-change trigger for risk reassessment (POL-01 4.3)
gap: Trigger is new; Campus 3 and AI tools were never assessed when introduced
remediation: Tie the trigger to purchasing and AI intake (POAM-023)

control_description: Annual co-sourced internal audit; MSSP 24x7 monitoring; annual Title IV compliance audit
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M and reported quarterly to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the Moderate baseline and mapped to risks (P02)
General IT controls over the partner portal, SIS, and integration platform
gap: Integration and SIS changes bypass change management; no configuration baselines for cloud servers

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-17; standards index
gap: 7 standards still in draft

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with SSO and MFA for staff; partner portal sign-in; privileged access broker for cloud
evidence: Conditional access policy; partner portal settings
gap: Partner portal users sign in with passwords only; SaaS administrators use standing accounts; students may opt out of MFA
remediation: Partner MFA (POAM-019); privileged access management (POAM-004); student MFA (POAM-001)

control_description: Accounts created from HR and SIS records; partner users created on partner request
gap: Local LMS accounts and servicer accounts created without data owner approval

control_description: Role-based access in the SIS, LMS, warehouse, and partner portal
gap: Broad SIS and warehouse access; annual reviews only; prior roles kept on transfer
remediation: Role redesign, warehouse views, semiannual reviews (POAM-002, POAM-004)

control_description: Badge access to offices and closets; provider data centers inherited
gap: Campus 3 closets use keys without a log

control_description: Drive disposal with certificates
gap: Copiers returned without sanitization; no retention schedule

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Cloud hub firewall and web application firewall in front of the partner portal
gap: Campus 3 flat network; vendor always-on remote tool

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for the portal and interfaces; encrypted partner file feeds
gap: Aid spreadsheets emailed unencrypted (outside partner scope but same staff and tools); 4 partner feeds lack interconnection terms

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all staff endpoints and servers; allow-listing on staff devices
evidence: EDR coverage report; device management policy

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning and annual penetration testing
gap: Late critical remediation; partner portal not in the penetration test scope

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP monitors SIEM and EDR alerts 24x7
gap: No monitoring of SIS, LMS, or partner portal user activity; simulated account takeover raised no alert

control_description: Security events triaged by the MSSP and the security team
gap: Fraud events were handled outside the incident process

control_description: POL-03 and the P08 runbooks approved 2026-09-17
gap: Runbooks not yet exercised

control_description: Recovery from incidents through backups and vendor recovery
gap: No IT DR plan; the integration platform restore failed during P07

control_description: Change tickets for cloud infrastructure; contractor releases of the partner portal
gap: SIS and integration changes not controlled; no code review evidence for portal releases before 2026

control_description: BIA (P05), cyber insurance, and recovery priorities
gap: Business disruption controls rely on an IT DR plan that does not exist yet

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor contracts and SOC 2 reviews (Part B)
gap: 22 vendors lack security and FERPA terms; 6 of 14 Tier 1 reviews outstanding

control_description: Capacity monitoring for the partner portal; SaaS and cloud capacity managed by providers
evidence: Portal capacity dashboard; provider SOC 2 reports

control_description: Daily write-once backups in a second region; provider environmental protections inherited
gap: The integration platform license server is not backed up (found in the P07 restore test)
remediation: Add it to the backup plan (POAM-011)

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: No restore or DR test of the partner portal or integration platform
remediation: Quarterly restore tests (POAM-011); partner portal test (POAM-019)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Partner data classified as Restricted (POL-04); partner-scoped views in the portal
gap: POL-04 effective only from 2026-10-01; consent checks for partner reporting are manual (2 of 20 sampled without current consent)
remediation: Automated consent check in the partner feed

control_description: Disposal of confidential information
gap: No retention and disposal schedule for partner data
